8394-the-doings-of-raffles-haw.creator: Arthur Conan Doyle

Yet, as he was wont himself to say, when one thinks that each poor mortal is heir to a legacy of every evil trait or bodily taint of so vast a line of ancestors, lucky indeed is the man who does not find that Nature has scored up some long-owing family debt upon his features.

arxiv-1809-07467.title: Morita Equivalent Blocks of Symmetric Groups This paper is a contribution to the Special Issue on the Representation Theory of the Symmetric Groups and Related Topics. The full collection is available at https://www.emis.de/journals/SIGMA/symmetric-groups-2018.html
arxiv-1809-07467.creator: Benjamin SAMBALE
arxiv-1809-07467.description: Abstract A well-known result of Scopes states that there are only finitely many Morita equivalence classes of p p -blocks of symmetric groups with a given weight (or defect). In this note we investigate a lower bound on the number of those Morita equivalence classes.

arxiv-2208-03058.title: Multi-Axis Control of a Qubit in the Presence of Unknown Non-Markovian Quantum Noise
arxiv-2208-03058.creator: Akram Youssry, Hendra I. Nurdin
arxiv-2208-03058.description: Abstract In this paper, we consider the problem of open-loop control of a qubit that is coupled to an unknown fully quantum non-Markovian noise (either bosonic or fermionic). A graybox model that is empirically obtained from measurement data is employed to approximately represent the unknown quantum noise.

arxiv-2306-01406.title: Entanglement and Teleportation in a 1-D Network with Repeaters
arxiv-2306-01406.creator: Ganesh Mylavarapu ∗ , Indranil Chakrabarty ∗ , Kaushiki Mukherjee ∗∗ , Minyi Huang + , Junde Wu ++
arxiv-2306-01406.description: Abstract The most simplest form of quantum network is an one dimensional quantum network with a single player in each node. In remote entanglement distribution each of the players carry out measurement at the intermediate nodes to produce an entangled state between initial and final node which are remotely separated.

arxiv-2405-02164.title: A Shifted Parking Function Symmetric Function
arxiv-2405-02164.creator: Richard P. Stanley
arxiv-2405-02164.description: Abstract . We define a “shifted analogue” SH n \mathrm{SH}_{n} of the parking function symmetric function PF n \mathrm{PF}_{n} . The expansion of SH n \mathrm{SH}_{n} in terms of three bases for shifted symmetric functions is explicitly described. We don’t know a shifted analogue for parking functions themselves, but some desirable properties of such an analogue are discussed. 1.

arxiv-2410-05875.title: Quintessence scalar field and cosmological constant: Dynamics of a multi-component dark energy model
arxiv-2410-05875.creator: Prasanta Sahoo, Nandan Roy, Himadri Shekhar Mondal
arxiv-2410-05875.description: Abstract This study explores the dynamics and phase-space behavior of a multi-component dark energy model, where the dark sector consists of a minimally coupled canonical scalar field and the cosmological constant, using a dynamical system analysis setup for various types of potential for which a general parameterization of the scalar field potentials has been considered.

arxiv-2503-17433.title: Congruences on posets, relatively pseudocomplemented and Boolean posets
arxiv-2503-17433.creator: Ivan Chajda, Helmut Länger
arxiv-2503-17433.description: Abstract The aim of the present paper is to extend the concept of a congruence from lattices to posets. We use an approach different from that used by the first author and V. Snášel in [ 6 ] . By using our definition we show that congruence classes are convex.

arxiv-2504-04997.title: SurvSurf: a partially monotonic neural network for first-hitting time prediction of intermittently observed discrete and continuous sequential events
arxiv-2504-04997.creator: Yichen Kelly Chen \ORCID 0009-0001-8412-3141, Sören Dittmer \ORCID 0000-0003-2919-4956, Kinga Bernatowicz, Josep Arús-Pous \ORCID 0000-0002-9860-2944, Kamen Bliznashki, John Aston \ORCID 0000-0002-3770-9342, James H.F. Rudd \ORCID 0000-0003-2243-3117, Carola-Bibiane Schönlieb \ORCID 0000-0003-0099-6
arxiv-2504-04997.description: Abstract We propose a neural-network based survival model (SurvSurf) specifically designed for direct and simultaneous probabilistic prediction of the first hitting time of sequential events from baseline. Unlike existing models, SurvSurf is theoretically guaranteed to never violate the monotonic relationship between the cumulative incidence functions of sequential events, while allowing nonlinear influence from predictors.

arxiv-2506-08182.title: Quantum Resource Comparison for Two Leading Surface Code Lattice Surgery Approaches 1 Corresponding author: tylerleblond@gmail.com.
arxiv-2506-08182.creator: Tyler LeBlond 1, Ryan S. Bennink
arxiv-2506-08182.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Tyler LeBlond 1, Ryan S. Bennink. Hamiltonian simulation is one of the most promising candidates for the demonstration of quantum advantage within the next ten years, and several studies have proposed end-to-end resource estimates for executing such algorithms on fault-tolerant quantum processors. Usually, these resource estimates are based upon the assumption that quantum error correction is implemented using the surface code, and that the best surface code compilation scheme involves serializing input circuits by eliminating all Clifford gates.

arxiv-2510-08451.title: Non-Clifford Gates are Required for Long-Term Memory
arxiv-2510-08451.creator: Jon Nelson ∗†, Joel Rajakumar ∗‡, Michael J. Gullans
arxiv-2510-08451.description: Abstract We show that all Clifford circuits under interspersed depolarizing noise lose memory of their input exponentially quickly, even when given access to a constant supply of fresh qubits in arbitrary states. This is somewhat surprising given the result of [ AB97 ] which gives a fault-tolerant protocol for general quantum circuits using a supply of fresh qubits.

arxiv-2510-13499.title: ConsintBench: Evaluating Language Models on Real-World Consumer Intent Understanding
arxiv-2510-13499.creator: Xiaozhe Li, TianYi Lyu, Siyi Yang, Yuxi Gong, Yizhao Yang, Jinxuan Huang, Ligao Zhang, Zhuoyi Huang, Qingwen Liu, Tongji University, Stanford University, Currents AI https://github.com/OliverLeeXZ/ConsintBench
arxiv-2510-13499.description: Abstract Understanding human intent is a complex, high-level task for large language models (LLMs), requiring analytical reasoning, contextual interpretation, dynamic information aggregation, and decision-making under uncertainty. Real-world public discussions, such as consumer product discussions, are rarely linear or involve a single user.

pmc-10653222.title: Growth of Coal Mining Operations in the Elk River Valley (Canada) Linked to Increasing Solute Transport of Se, NO3–, and SO42– into the Transboundary Koocanusa Reservoir (USA–Canada)
pmc-10653222.creator: Meryl B Storb, Ashley M Bussell, Sara L Caldwell Eldridge, Robert M Hirsch, Travis S Schmidt
pmc-10653222.description: Koocanusa Reservoir (KOC) is a waterbody that spans the United States (U.S.) and Canadian border. Increasing concentrations of total selenium (Se), nitrate + nitrite (NO3–, nitrite is insignificant or not present), and sulfate (SO42–) in KOC and downstream in the Kootenai River (Kootenay River in Canada) are tied to expanding coal mining operations in the Elk River Watershed, Canada.

pmc-11503511.title: Digestion-Free Middle-Down Mass Spectrometry Method for Absolute Quantification of Conjugated Payload from Antibody-Drug Conjugates
pmc-11503511.creator: Jiaqi Yuan, Hui Yin Tan, Yue Huang, Anton I Rosenbaum
pmc-11503511.description: Antibody-drug conjugate (ADC) is a therapeutic modality that aims to improve payload delivery specificity and reduce systemic toxicity. Considering the complex structure of ADCs, various bioanalytical methods by liquid chromatography coupled with mass spectrometry (LC-MS), ligand binding assay (LBA) and hybrid LBA-LC-MS approaches have been established for ADC characterization and quantification.

pmc-11549140.title: Evaluation of AJCC Nodal Staging for Intraductal Papillary Mucinous Neoplasm-Derived Pancreatic Ductal Adenocarcinoma

The role of nodal disease and the AJCC’s prognostic utility for IPMN-derived pancreatic cancer are unclear.

pmc-12404204.title: Sex-specific transcriptome dynamics of Anopheles gambiae during embryonic development
pmc-12404204.creator: Agata Izabela Kalita, Eric Marois, Frank Rühle, Claudia Isabelle Keller Valsecchi
pmc-12404204.description: In this study, Kalita et al. detail the sex-specific transcriptomes and gene expression dynamics during Anopheles embryogenesis, highlighting the differences in alternative polyadenylation and splicing during zygotic genome activation. Furthermore, they report that the sexually dimorphic regulator SOA mediates X-linked dosage compensation that underpins sex-biased gene expression, representing a mechanism of collective, chromosome-level, gene regulation.

pmc-13067057.title: Markers for the Severity of Multisystem Inflammatory Syndrome in Children: A Multivariate Analysis
pmc-13067057.creator: Georgi Vasilev, Nadzhie Gorelyova, Russka Shumnalieva, Latchezar Tomov, Dayana Gandi Abousaid, Iren Tzotcheva, Snezhina Lazova, Tsvetelina Velikova, Samuel Menahem
pmc-13067057.description: BackgroundOur goals were to find and grade children with multisystem inflammatory syndrome (MIS‐C) by clinical severity and the degree of different system involvement based on multivariate clinical laboratory data and identify the best predictors and scores for disease prognosis and risk stratification.

pmc-13277645.title: Synergistic effects of ultrasound and stirring on crystallization behavior of coconut oil: Physicochemical properties, crystallinity and potential mechanism
pmc-13277645.creator: Huiting Yang, Yuting Fu, Siyuan Xu, Jingya Xue, Jun Cao
pmc-13277645.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Precise control of coconut oil crystallization is essential for tailoring its structural and functional attributes. However, chemical modification often encounters constraints, and mechanisms of physical modulation, such as ultrasound and stirring, remain to be fully explored. In this work, the independent and combined effects of ultrasound and mechanical stirring on the crystallization of virgin coconut oil (VCO) and refined, bleached, deodorized coconut oil (RBD) were investigated. All treatments accelerated nucleation and crystal growth, with the combined field showing the strongest effect.

pmc-13447860.title: Sonochemical boron incorporation enhances activity and durability of ruthenium oxide for acidic water oxidation
pmc-13447860.creator: Tianrui Xue, Zhongliang Liu, Heng Liu, Shiqi Li, Yiting Song, Zhen He, Yongjun Shen, Kai Zhou, Shixin Yin, Jian Zhang, Jiayan Huang, Yi Shi, Hao Li, Zhen-Yu Wu, Huihui Li, Chunzhong Li, Shu-Hong Yu
pmc-13447860.description: The inherent instability of ruthenium oxide in acidic environments, coupled with the persistent activity-stability trade-off, constitutes a fundamental barrier to advancement of proton exchange membrane water electrolyzers. Here we show a cavitation-mediated sonochemical strategy that enables homogeneous substitutional boron doping of ruthenium oxide within minutes under ambient conditions.

pmc-13585106.creator: Simran P Desai, Dhananjaya Gaviappa, Somashekar Ankanahalli Ramu, Lalitha S Jairam, Maanya Vijay
pmc-13585106.description: BackgroundThe hallmark signs of upper airway resistance syndrome (UARS) include increased breathing effort, frequent arousals during sleep, and daytime drowsiness without noticeable problems with oxygenation or airflow. It may involve craniofacial traits such as a long face, small mouth, retrognathia, nasal obstruction, narrow throat, and high palate and primarily affects young, thin people who suffer from insomnia.
